title: Conditional κ = 0.003642959019031 (+5.50522162e-7 over #7131): causal-history buffer split
body:
This adds a source-bound causal-history split with conditional **κ = 0.003642959019031**, a gain of **0.000000550522162 over #7131**. Seven timed gathers, two explicitly owned buffers and one later injection split a rank-nine helper into ranks four and five. One paid path changes from rank six to ranks one and five; all added storage and scalar work is charged. Ali Romman supplied the causal-history mechanism; this package supplies the new exact instance and complete application.

The complete word adds 27 ADDs, four SCALEs, one MOVE, two INITs and two CLEARs. Owned inventory changes from 51 labels/54 lifetimes/peak 43 to **53/56/44**. The 17-stage application has **110,417 paid positions**, **22,325 productive fields**, surplus 1,424, zero empty credit, ordinary source-unit work **779,064,884 < 10⁹**, and precision **c=2362** on the freshly derived **1125/F25** grid. The original caller is byte-identical.

All three direct CPython 3.14.7 commands and the final registered isolated CPython 3.12.16 replay passed, matching every frozen receipt field. All 23 scientific hashes stayed unchanged. Coverage includes the source-reconstructed timed coefficient certificate; full forward/adjoint and COPY/lifecycle checks; 18 native corruption controls; phase and five 512-column chart checks; finite physical replay; all **3,039 paid/helper maps and 104 main boundaries**; both directed prices; fresh owned-stock, ordinary, precision and compiler/fixed-tape costs; and **54 strict + 4 functional outer conditions**. The first native attempt stopped on the old fixed lifecycle census. Counted adapters now retain its exact check against (56,44,53), and an extra uncharged lifetime is rejected. Frozen source bytes are unchanged.
